data.text:
Virendra Kumar Yadav vs Hemant Rao Prin. Secy. Food Safety 
And ... on 19 January, 2024 
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench 
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:5970
Court No. - 19
Case :- Contempt Application (Civil) No. - 943 of 2015 
Applicant :- Virendra Kumar Yadav
Opposite Party :- Hemant Rao Prin. Secy. Food Safety And Drug Admisnistration 
Counsel for Applicant :- B.K. Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- C S C
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
1. Case called out.
2. None present for the petitioner, however, learned Standing Counsel for the State is present. 
3. It seems that by the efflux of time, this contempt petition has become infructuous. 
4. Accordingly, the contempt petition is dismissed as having become infructuous. 
5. Contempt notices are hereby discharged. 
6. If the petitioner feels that the cause of action still survives, he may move an application for recall of the order within eight weeks.
